summary: Tested public backend endpoints, production dashboard load, menu, search, protocol confirmation, financial module, and mobile layout. Core flows pass; live telemetry menu action does not update displayed telemetry.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking menu-settings-button changes demoMode state but does not rerun analysis, so telemetry-status remains DEMO STREAM and the user sees no live-mode result.

action_items: Make the telemetry mode menu action trigger a fresh analysis (or otherwise update analysis state) and show LIVE STREAM when live mode succeeds; preserve a clear fallback message when live sources fail.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js useEffect calls unstable runAnalysis and build emits exhaustive-deps warning; stabilize the callback with useCallback or move initial request logic into the effect to avoid stale state and duplicate/incorrect requests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/, GET /api/financial, demo flood analysis, invalid-coordinate validation passed. Enter preset search, preset click, protocol confirmation, financial UI, and 390px no-overflow passed. Retest menu-settings-button after wiring it to rerun analysis.
rca of the issue: The settings button handler only executes setDemoMode(!demoMode) at App.js line 39. analysis remains the prior response, and telemetry-status derives from analysis.is_demo_mode rather than demoMode, so the visible stream badge cannot change until another analysis is run.
